description: Role/tool protocol for the TeamHarness MCP server, extracted as data from mcp/server.py @ d8332e0a. Tool-level visibility comes from _visible_tool_names (message hidden for MESSAGE_TOOL_BLOCKED_ROLES); action-level gates are the 'requires ... role' checks in projectflow/taskflow. leader/worker/remote-member carry real gates in the code; critic/writer/coordinator have NO role gate anywhere in mcp/server.py - they are default-allowed on every tool (they are not in the message block set) and are rejected per-action by the positive gates with the 'requires ... role' error.
role_resolution: AGENTTEAMS_AGENT_ROLE env, then AGENTTEAMS_WORKER_ROLE env, then runtime config member.role; the per-call `role` argument is a fallback only when the runtime role resolves empty. Values are normalized (strip, '_' -> '-', lowercase).

action_gates.error: ack_task requires worker or remote-member role

submit_task requires worker or remote-member role

ungated_note: No role check exists in the code for: health; roomflow (create_task_room, list_rooms, describe_room, archive_room); filesync (list, stat, pull, push); artifact (publish_file); message for non-blocked roles; projectflow (create_project, create_quick_project, resolve_project, list_events, mark_requester_report_sent, plan_dag, plan_loop, ready_nodes, ready_loop_nodes, record_loop_iteration, pause_project, resume_project, complete_project). taskflow is fully gated per action.
